title: AI opens new era in cognitive studies of wild primates
excerpt: Animals in general, I would think. Pattern recognition will go a long way toward decoding some difficult cognition-related questions we have about animals, in particular how they communicate.
content_html:
AI opens new era in cognitive studies of wild primates (emory.edu)
30 points by hhs 23 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 8 comments
 help


Animals in general, I would think. Pattern recognition will go a long way toward decoding some difficult cognition-related questions we have about animals, in particular how they communicate.


so their idea is to put an ipad in the middle of the forest, installed with games, and if played right, delievers a treat... makes me wonder if something alien civilization is not doing something like that to us.


> makes me wonder if something alien civilization is not doing something like that

Big Tech is doing that to us.

When we make the algo happy we get treats - likes, shares, followers - dopamine hits.


What about the fact that he *looks* human through and through? That's generally an indicator with ~100% prediction success.
